title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the force as F = Q^2/(32πε₀R²).

title: Surface Charge Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the surface charge density as σ = Q/(4πR²).

title: Force Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration process to calculate the force from the surface charge density.

title: Coordinate System
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the coordinate system used for the integration, clarifying the geometry of the problem.

title: Units Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the final answer has the correct units of force (Newtons).

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the force calculation.
